input.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
input.description:
About the role

I run a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand with a 40+ person team, including an in-house editing team that produces video ads every day. Tech is the part of the company I'm investing in the most right now: today it's one senior engineer, and it's going to become a real department.


I'm hiring a second senior developer to work side by side with him on custom AI tools for the editing team: automatic video generation, AI talking heads, and pipelines that turn one winning ad into many variations.


What you'll build

 * AI video pipelines for ads with Higgsfield, Kie AI, Kling, Veo, Seedance, ElevenLabs and similar models and APIs
 * Automatic assembly of long multi-scene ads (ffmpeg, Remotion or similar): captions, audio, transitions
 * A browser-based editing tool where the editors fine-tune what the AI generates
 * AI talking heads and lip sync for video ads


What I'm looking for

 * A senior developer with strong engineering fundamentals
 * Hands-on experience with AI video generation and video processing (FFmpeg, Remotion or similar)
 * Full-time and exclusive, available to start soon


What you get

 * Real responsibility and a lot of freedom from day one
 * Growth tied to impact, up to leading a team as the department grows
 * Very well paid, full-time, remote, long term


Big plus if you speak Serbian, Croatian or Bosnian, like my senior engineer.
